Body.Content:
Store associates can select multiple eligible transaction lines and apply common updates in one action, including voiding items, changing the delivery mode, and changing the fulfillment location. This capability reduces repetitive work and errors on large orders while preserving line-level validation and providing clear feedback when an update can't be applied.

Multiselect supports touch, keyboard, and mouse interactions, and partners can extend it with additional bulk actions for their workflows. Administrators can enable the capability for selected Store Commerce layouts in Commerce headquarters.

GA date: September CY2026

Preview date: July CY2026
